format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: slide-next shows the next slide and sends change {activeIndex, realIndex, previousIndex}, then the old name
the change detail is data only (§8)

steps.script: new Promise((done) => { const el = document.getElementById('s1'); setTimeout(() => { el.addEventListener('change', (e) => done(Object.keys(e.detail).sort().join(',')), {once: true}); el.slideNext(); }, 600); })

probes.title: the arrows are named by the language file and move the slides

steps.check: (() => { const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('#s1 [aria-label]')].map((n) => n.getAttribute('aria-label')); return labels.includes('Следующий слайд') && labels.includes('Предыдущий слайд'); })()

probes.title: refresh answers applied; getSlider is kept and noted
indicator="inside" stands the dots over the picture and takes the ink by the slide under them: dark on a light slide, light on a dark one; indicator-ink="outline" is the page's (C398)

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#s2 .sf-slider'); const bar = root.querySelector('.sf-slider-dots'); const pic = root.querySelector('.sf-slider-main').getBoundingClientRect(); const box = bar.getBoundingClientRect(); return root.dataset.indicator === 'inside' && root.dataset.ink === 'dark' && box.bottom < pic.bottom && box.top > pic.top; })()

steps.script: new Promise((done) => { const el = document.getElementById('s2'); el.slideNext(); setTimeout(() => done(el.querySelector('.sf-slider').dataset.ink), 700); })
